2026-04-15

df <- read.csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv")

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AvgFullProfSalary, AvgAssocProfSalary, AvgAssistProfSalary),
    names_to = "Rank",
    values_to = "Salary"
  )
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = case_when(
      Rank == "AvgAssistProfSalary" ~ "Assist",
      Rank == "AvgAssocProfSalary" ~ "Assoc",
      Rank == "AvgFullProfSalary" ~ "Full"
    )
  )
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = factor(Rank, levels = c("Assist", "Assoc", "Full")),
    Tier = factor(Tier, levels = c("I", "IIA", "IIB"))
  )

ggplot(
  df_long |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Rank), !is.na(Tier)),
  aes(x = Rank, y = Salary, fill = Rank)
) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Tier, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Assist" = "#F8766D",
    "Assoc" = "#00BA38",
    "Full" = "#619CFF"
  )) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Rank", y = "Salary", fill = "Rank") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.border = element_blank(),   
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
  )
## Warning: Removed 128 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_boxplot()`).

 ggsave("plot.png", width = 12, height = 3)
## Warning: Removed 128 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_boxplot()`).
anova_model <- aov(Salary ~ State + Tier + Rank, data = df_long)
summary(anova_model)

## 131 observations deleted due to missingness
juniper <- read.csv("Juniper_Oils.csv")
juniper_long <- juniper %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      alpha.pinene, para.cymene, alpha.terpineol, cedr.9.ene,
      alpha.cedrene, beta.cedrene, cis.thujopsene, alpha.himachalene,
      beta.chamigrene, cuparene, compound.1, alpha.chamigrene, widdrol,
      cedrol, beta.acorenol, alpha.acorenol, gamma.eudesmol, beta.eudesmol,
      alpha.eudesmol, cedr.8.en.13.ol, cedr.8.en.15.ol, compound.2,
      thujopsenal
    ),
    names_to = "Compound",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  )
ggplot(juniper_long, aes(x = YearsSinceBurn, y = Concentration)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue", fill = "grey80") +
  facet_wrap(~ Compound, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Years Since Burn",
    y = "Concentration"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey92")
  )
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

library(broom)
library(dplyr)

model <- glm(Concentration ~ Compound * YearsSinceBurn,
             data = juniper_long)

significant_results <- tidy(model) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

significant_results
